title: Use Seedance 2.0 with Higgsfield by dropping the prompt into Higgsfield and…
content:
Use Seedance 2.0 with Higgsfield by dropping the prompt into Higgsfield and attaching both character reference sheets as @jungle-prince and @phoenix-drake to lock identity consistency.

Add an ACTIVE REFERENCES section with 100% matches the reference and identical every frame for each tagged subject to prevent design drift across frames.

Specify a non-empty FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING description (subjects already in motion, nothing frozen) to avoid static or empty opening frames.

Force a single-shot result by explicitly prompting Single continuous take, 15s and reiterating no cuts in FORMAT MODE.

Lock camera behavior by stating a chase camera locked BEHIND for the entire clip with a fixed distance (0.5–0.8m) to keep consistent framing.

Control motion blur by specifying 180° shutter motion blur and no drift in the OPTICS/CAMERA sections.

Direct a speed ramp by prompting one in-camera speed ramp into super slow motion at a specific timestamp window (4–6s) and a hard snap back to real-time.

Use a wide-angle look by specifying 107° FOV, wide rectilinear, prime-lens character to shape perspective and lens feel.

Maintain subject framing during focus effects by instructing the camera to keep rear position and rack focus onto a butterfly at the lens during the slow-mo beat.

Prevent unwanted audio/text artifacts by explicitly prompting NO MUSIC, SFX ONLY, no dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

Reinforce key constraints with a POSITIVE LOCKS section (camera stays behind, colossal scale held, exact reference design every frame, eyes stay natural/no eye glow, contact shadows read clearly) to reduce model deviations.

Dirige un speed ramp indicando uno in-camera speed ramp into super slow motion en una ventana temporal específica (4–6s) y un hard snap back to real-time.

Usa un look de gran angular especificando 107° FOV, wide rectilinear, prime-lens character para dar forma a la perspectiva y al carácter de la lente.

Mantén el encuadre del sujeto durante los efectos de enfoque instruyendo a la cámara a mantener la posición trasera y rack focus onto a butterfly at the lens durante el beat de slow-mo.

Ajoutez une section ACTIVE REFERENCES avec 100% matches the reference et identique à chaque frame pour chaque sujet tagué afin d’éviter toute dérive du design d’une frame à l’autre.

Précisez une description FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING non vide (sujets déjà en mouvement, rien de figé) pour éviter des frames d’ouverture statiques ou vides.

Forcez un résultat en single-shot en demandant explicitement Single continuous take, 15s et en répétant no cuts dans FORMAT MODE.

Verrouillez le comportement de la caméra en indiquant une chase camera locked BEHIND pendant tout le clip avec une distance fixe (0.5–0.8m) afin de conserver un cadrage cohérent.

Orientez un speed ramp en demandant un in-camera speed ramp vers du super slow motion sur une fenêtre temporelle précise (4–6s) puis un retour brutal au temps réel.

Adoptez un rendu grand-angle en spécifiant 107° FOV, wide rectilinear, prime-lens character pour façonner la perspective et la sensation de l’objectif.

Maintenez le cadrage du sujet pendant les effets de focus en demandant à la caméra de rester en position arrière et de faire un rack focus sur un papillon au niveau de l’objectif pendant le passage en slow-mo.

Évitez les artefacts audio/texte indésirables en demandant explicitement NO MUSIC, SFX ONLY, no dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

ja.content:
Seedance 2.0 を Higgsfield で使うには、prompt を Higgsfield に投入し、両方の character reference sheet を @jungle-prince と @phoenix-drake として添付して、identity の一貫性を固定します。

ACTIVE REFERENCES セクションを追加し、各タグ付き subject について reference と 100% 一致し、全フレームで完全に同一になるようにして、フレーム間の design drift を防ぎます。

静止した、または空の冒頭フレームを避けるため、空欄ではない FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING の説明を指定します（subjects はすでに動いており、何も frozen ではない）。

FORMAT MODE では、Single continuous take, 15s を明示的に prompt し、さらに no cuts を繰り返して、単一ショットの結果を強制します。

カメラの挙動は、クリップ全体を通して BEHIND に固定された chase camera とし、一定の距離（0.5–0.8m）を指定して、フレーミングの一貫性を保ちます。

180° shutter motion blur を指定し、OPTICS/CAMERA セクションで no drift と明記して、モーションブラーを制御します。

4–6s の特定の timestamp window で in-camera speed ramp を super slow motion に入れ、そこから real-time へ hard snap back するよう prompt して、speed ramp を指示します。

107° FOV、wide rectilinear、prime-lens character を指定して wide-angle の見た目にし、パースとレンズの質感を形作ります。

slow-mo のビート中に、カメラが rear position を維持しつつ、レンズの前の butterfly に rack focus するよう指示して、フォーカス効果中の subject framing を維持します。

NO MUSIC, SFX ONLY, no dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark を明示的に prompt して、不要な audio/text artifacts を防ぎます。

POSITIVE LOCKS セクションで主要な制約を強化し（camera stays behind, colossal scale held, exact reference design every frame, eyes stay natural/no eye glow, contact shadows read clearly）、モデルの逸脱を抑えます。

ko.content:
Seedance 2.0를 Higgsfield와 함께 사용하려면, 프롬프트를 Higgsfield에 넣고 두 캐릭터 레퍼런스 시트를 @jungle-prince와 @phoenix-drake로 첨부해 아이덴티티 일관성을 고정하세요.

ACTIVE REFERENCES 섹션을 추가해 각 태그된 피사체에 대해 레퍼런스와 100% 일치하고 모든 프레임에서 동일하게 유지되도록 하여, 프레임 간 디자인 드리프트를 방지하세요.

정적이거나 빈 오프닝 프레임을 피하기 위해, 비어 있지 않은 FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING 설명을 명시하세요(피사체는 이미 움직이고 있어야 하며, 아무것도 정지해 있으면 안 됨).

FORMAT MODE에서 Single continuous take, 15s를 명시적으로 프롬프트하고 no cuts를 반복해 단일 샷 결과를 강제하세요.

전체 클립 동안 chase camera locked BEHIND를 고정 거리(0.5–0.8m)와 함께 명시해 카메라 동작을 잠그고, 일관된 프레이밍을 유지하세요.

OPTICS/CAMERA 섹션에서 180° shutter motion blur와 no drift를 지정해 모션 블러를 제어하세요.

4–6초의 특정 타임스탬프 구간에서 one in-camera speed ramp into super slow motion을 프롬프트하고, 이어서 hard snap back to real-time을 지정해 속도 램프를 연출하세요.

107° FOV, wide rectilinear, prime-lens character를 지정해 와이드앵글 룩을 사용하고, 원근감과 렌즈 느낌을 형성하세요.

슬로모 구간에서 카메라가 rear position을 유지하고 렌즈 앞의 나비에 rack focus하도록 지시해 포커스 효과 중에도 피사체 프레이밍을 유지하세요.

NO MUSIC, SFX ONLY, no dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark를 명시적으로 프롬프트해 원치 않는 오디오/텍스트 아티팩트를 방지하세요.

POSITIVE LOCKS 섹션으로 핵심 제약을 강화하세요(카메라는 뒤에 유지, 거대한 스케일 유지, 정확한 레퍼런스 디자인을 모든 프레임에서 유지, 눈은 자연스럽게 유지/눈빛 발광 없음, 접촉 그림자가 선명하게 보임)하여 모델의 이탈을 줄이세요.

pt.content:
Use o Seedance 2.0 com o Higgsfield, inserindo o prompt no Higgsfield e anexando ambas as reference sheets dos personagens como @jungle-prince e @phoenix-drake para travar a consistência da identidade.

Adicione uma seção ACTIVE REFERENCES com 100% matches the reference e identical every frame para cada sujeito marcado, a fim de evitar deriva de design entre os frames.

Especifique uma descrição FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING não vazia (sujeitos já em movimento, nada congelado) para evitar frames iniciais estáticos ou vazios.

Force um resultado de single-shot explicitamente com o prompt Single continuous take, 15s e reiterando no cuts em FORMAT MODE.

Trave o comportamento da câmera dizendo que é uma chase camera locked BEHIND durante todo o clipe, com distância fixa (0.5–0.8m), para manter o enquadramento consistente.

Controle o motion blur especificando 180° shutter motion blur e no drift nas seções OPTICS/CAMERA.

Direcione um speed ramp com um in-camera speed ramp para super slow motion em uma janela de timestamp específica (4–6s) e um hard snap back to real-time.

Use um visual wide-angle especificando 107° FOV, wide rectilinear, prime-lens character para moldar a perspectiva e a sensação da lente.

Mantenha o enquadramento do sujeito durante efeitos de foco instruindo a câmera a manter a posição traseira e fazer rack focus para uma borboleta na lente durante o trecho em slow-mo.

Evite artefatos indesejados de áudio/texto especificando explicitamente NO MUSIC, SFX ONLY, no dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark.

Reforce as restrições principais com uma seção POSITIVE LOCKS (camera stays behind, colossal scale held, exact reference design every frame, eyes stay natural/no eye glow, contact shadows read clearly) para reduzir desvios do modelo.

zh.content:
使用 Seedance 2.0 搭配 Higgsfield：将 prompt 直接放入 Higgsfield，并附上两张角色参考图，分别标记为 @jungle-prince 和 @phoenix-drake，以锁定身份一致性。

添加一个 ACTIVE REFERENCES 部分，要求与参考图 100% 匹配，并且每一帧都与参考图完全一致，针对每个已标记主体都要如此，以防止跨帧设计漂移。

指定一个非空的 FIRST FRAME / BLOCKING 描述（主体已经在运动中，不能是静止状态），以避免开场画面静态或空白。

通过在 FORMAT MODE 中明确提示 Single continuous take, 15s，并反复强调 no cuts，来强制输出单镜头结果。

通过说明整个片段中 camera 始终锁定在 BEHIND 的 chase camera，并设置固定距离（0.5–0.8m），来锁定镜头行为，保持构图一致。

通过在 OPTICS/CAMERA 部分指定 180° shutter motion blur 和 no drift，来控制运动模糊。

通过提示在 4–6s 的特定时间窗口内进行一次 in-camera speed ramp，切换到 super slow motion，并再硬切回 real-time，来实现速度渐变。

通过指定 107° FOV、wide rectilinear、prime-lens character，来使用广角风格并塑造透视和镜头质感。

在对焦效果期间，通过指示 camera 保持 rear position，并在慢动作段对准镜头前的一只蝴蝶进行 rack focus，来维持主体构图。

通过明确提示 NO MUSIC, SFX ONLY, no dialogue, no subtitles, no on-screen text, no watermark，来防止不需要的音频/文字伪影。

通过添加一个 POSITIVE LOCKS 部分来强化关键约束（camera stays behind、colossal scale held、exact reference design every frame、eyes stay natural/no eye glow、contact shadows read clearly），以减少模型偏差。
